articles.title: Opinion | Kalshi’s sports bets are everywhere. They’re also likely illegal.
articles.summary: Kalshi, the prediction markets platform, is getting slapped with legal pushback over sports betting offerings that regulators say violate federal law. If the feds actually enforce this, it could crater the entire regulatory gray zone that lets prediction markets operate in the US.

articles.title: Best prediction market promos for Thanksgiving NFL Football: Collect up to $590 in bonuses
articles.summary: Sportsbooks are throwing ridiculous signup bonuses at Thanksgiving NFL games, with some packages topping $590 if you're willing to juggle multiple platforms. That kind of promotional firepower usually signals heavy competition for market share, which means sharp bettors can stack bonuses faster than Turkey Day leftovers disappear.

articles.title: Prediction markets push OpenAI IPO expectations later into 2027
articles.summary: OpenAI is now expected to go public sometime later in 2027 instead of earlier in the year, according to prediction market data. If true, it delays when early bettors can cash out their positions and shifts the timeline for one of tech's most anticipated IPOs by several months.

articles.title: Prediction markets, betting odds weigh in on whether LSU will actually leave the SEC
articles.summary: LSU is apparently considering bolting the SEC, and prediction markets are already pricing in the probability of this actually happening. The move would reshape college sports realignment and hand bettors a rare chance to profit from something that actually moves billion-dollar athletic conferences.

articles.title: Los Angeles Lakers Announce Partnership with Kalshi
articles.summary: The Lakers are partnering with Kalshi, the CFTC-regulated prediction market platform, marking a major sports team's official embrace of event contracts. This legitimizes prediction markets as a mainstream sports engagement tool and signals that regulated prediction betting is becoming the norm rather than the exception in professional sports.

articles.title: Utah scores win against Kalshi as company halts operations in state
articles.summary: Utah just blocked Kalshi from operating in the state, forcing the prediction markets platform to shut down there. It's a bellwether for how aggressively states will push back on the CFTC's recent approval of event contracts, which could reshape the entire prediction market landscape if other states follow suit.

articles.title: Kalshi Users Under 21 Lost $8.9 Million in NYC, Probe Finds
articles.summary: Kalshi, the CFTC-regulated prediction market platform, let users under 21 blow $8.9 million in New York City before regulators caught on to the age verification problem. This is basically the worst possible optics for an industry fighting to convince Congress and regulators that prediction markets can be trusted with real money.

articles.title: Young New Yorkers Are Losing on Kalshi, City Council Says
articles.summary: Young New Yorkers are apparently hemorrhaging money on Kalshi, the crypto-powered prediction market platform, prompting the city council to get involved. If regulators start cracking down on prediction markets over consumer protection concerns, it could tank the entire sector before it gets real traction with retail investors.
